body:
Remediate all 17 unique (19 total) SHOULD-FIX findings identified in Release Audit Run 3 for antigravity-booster 1.2.0, plus Antigravity 2.0 tool-name compatibility in hooks/policy/constants.mjs. Frozen rails lib/lock.mjs and lib/gates.mjs must remain untouched (enforced via adlc rails-guard --base main --rails lib/lock.mjs --rails lib/gates.mjs).
1. Scheduler & Worktrees (lib/scheduler.mjs, lib/worktrees.mjs): restore refs/heads/<base> to immutable baseRefSha before post-build and post-consensus-fix checks and pass baseRefSha to branchDiff/resetToBase; fail closed via compromiseRun when loadActiveRails(repo) fails on Strike 1/2 or consensus-fix; keep tempRef alive until markerRef/quarantine ref is written and defer agbRef deletion on post-merge failure to end-of-run cleanup; preserve leading space in isDirty() porcelain parsing; remove empty worktree/node_modules mountpoints in resetToBase and after runGates without modifying frozen rail lib/gates.mjs.
2. Policy Guard & Launcher (hooks/policy/constants.mjs, hooks/policy/evaluate.mjs, hooks/policy/shell.mjs, hooks/policy/paths.mjs, bin/node-launcher.sh): recognize Antigravity 2.0 read_file, write_file, and edit_file { Path } tool schemas; deny unresolved paths on read tools and Stage 1 shell readers unless targeting a benign /proc/<pid>/<stat-file> pseudo-file and strip /proc/*/root prefixes in matchRoot; reject .agb_home candidates and search USER_HOME before HOME in bin/node-launcher.sh while exporting AGB_USER_HOME; include host userHome in buildContext homes when HOME is isolated to .agb_home.
3. MCP & Install (mcp/server.mjs, lib/doctor.mjs, lib/bootstrap.mjs): validate args.repo in agb_doctor with requireNonFlagString and statSync().isDirectory(); verify exact hooks.json command and launcher script presence in checkPolicyGuard on win32 and surface win32 direct-bundle evaluation in detail; remove shell: process.platform === 'win32' from bootstrap() agy --version execFileSync probe.
4. Skills, Sidecar & Docs (skills/modernize/scripts/audit.mjs, skills/modernize/SKILL.md, sidecars/app.js, website/env-docs.json, website/content/docs/guides/sidecar-dashboard.mdx, website/content/docs/reference/cli/sidecar.mdx, AGENTS.md): fail Stage 1 on corrupted @adlc/cli manifest, accurately report unauthenticated shim in Stage 5 pre-upgrade summary, support offline ADLC_TARBALL_PATH and local roadmap fallback in Stage 5, mark modernize skill internal: true and align Stage 2 docs, clear ticketsGrid and poolStatus on dashboard reset, mark AGB_PLUGIN_DIR bundledIgnored: true in env-docs.json and sidecar docs, and update explicitAdlcPluginPath description in AGENTS.md.
title: Remediate Release Audit Run 3 SHOULD-FIX findings across scheduler, policy-guard, mcp, install, skills, sidecar, and docs
